preconditions: The output is an ordinary geological/lithological cross section, not an atmospheric or cavity analysis.
AboveTerrain is a validated non-geological background domain, not an inferred subsurface unit.
decisionLogic: Keep AboveTerrain/AIR mask for internal domain checks, but do not emit an air material swatch or label in the public lithology legend.
Explain actual geological units in the lithology legend and relevant line symbols separately.
Keep synthetic continuation, calculation limits and other uncertainty disclosures as explanatory notes/symbols, not invented lithologies.
Never use background suppression to conceal an internal geological gap or an unmodelled below-surface region.

unknownDisplayLabelPolicy.currentImplementationDomain: BelowModel without a bound synthetic basal continuation
unknownDisplayLabelPolicy.requiredNote: Explain that this is unmodelled extent below the calculation limit, not a lithology.
unknownDisplayLabelPolicy.semanticBoundary: Preserve BelowModel identity; do not relabel AIR, observed units, inferred continuation or unexplained internal missing cells.

uncertainty: Primary definitions and an inspected publication example support a purpose-specific design judgement; no explicit universal ban was located.
exclusions: Air treated as an explicit physical simulation medium

validationMethod.positive: Public legend contains only intended material entries and separated relevant symbols/notes.
validationMethod.negative: AboveTerrain label/swatch in an ordinary public material legend is detected.
validationMethod.boundary: Terrain clipping and zero-width exposed units do not alter AIR classification.
validationMethod.missingData: Missing terrain/domain evidence rejects geometry classification; do not fabricate air.
validationMethod.conflictingEvidence: Internal -1 cells remain failures and cannot be suppressed as background.
validationMethod.outOfScope: Explicit QA/physical-air render modes are evaluated against their own declared legend policy.

outOfScopeImplementation: Physical-air/QA render modes are not implemented or altered by this revision; model_domains retains explicit AIR codes.
reopenCondition: A publication/client requirement explicitly calls for air-medium legend entries, or the output purpose changes.
